race.comment: KOKONDA (2) franked his good trial form with an impressive maiden win fresh up by a head at Wangaratta just over 2 weeks ago when overcoming difficulties to get up in the final strides. This is not that much harder, and he can take the next step immediately. SIR LOYNE (5) finished sixth fresh up in his first start from the Ben Brisbourne stable at Wodonga, and the step up from 1300m to 1450m will suit him. He has had a couple of subtle gear changes and is expected to finish a lot closer this time. KASTUN STAR (9) has been given a long, slow build-up for his return, and he is ready now for the races after winning the 2 most recent of 6 trials since his last start at the end of March. He is ready to rumble, so don't risk him. ORNOS (10) resumes at an easier level so keep him very safe.
